title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! — The Cold Version #Shorts

Modern psychology keeps rediscovering what the pessimists said first about A Wild Last Boss Appeared!. A Wild Last Boss Appeared! (野生のラスボスが現れた！, Yasei no Rasu Bosu ga Arawareta!) is a Japanese light novel series written by Firehead and illustrated by YahaKo. It was initially serialized on the user-generated novel publishing website Shōsetsuka ni Narō from October 2015 to April 2019, before being acquired and published by Earth Star Entertainment under their Earth Star Novel imprint from February 2016 to April 2019.
